notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
description:
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Repeat.
